description: This file declares the class USBDeviceImplementation which implements the IUSBDevice interface for managing USB devices, including hotplug event handling, device info retrieval, and driver binding/unbinding. It contains class definitions, method declarations, and macro definitions related to USB device management within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: USBDeviceImplementation
classes.description: Implements the IUSBDevice interface, manages USB device hotplug events, device information retrieval, and driver binding/unbinding within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. Contains nested Job class for asynchronous event dispatching.

classes.name: USBDeviceImplementation::Job
classes.description: Represents a dispatchable job for handling USB device hotplug events asynchronously.

methods.description: Singleton accessor for USBDeviceImplementation instance.

methods.description: Registers a notification callback for USB device events.

methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback for USB device events.

methods.description: Retrieves the list of connected USB devices.

methods.name: GetDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific USB device.

methods.name: UnbindDriver
methods.description: Unbinds a driver from a specified USB device.
